name: awantura-o-kase
description: Awantura o kasę – aktywność na Discordzie

scripts.dev:discord: cross-env TUNNEL=1 concurrently -n serwer,strona -c blue,yellow "node --watch server/index.js" "vite"
scripts.discord: cross-env TUNNEL=1 concurrently -n serwer,strona,tunel -c blue,yellow,magenta "node --watch server/index.js" "vite" "cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:5173"
scripts.ngrok: npm run build && concurrently -n serwer,tunel -c blue,magenta "node server/index.js" "ngrok http 3001 --log stdout --log-format logfmt"
